referenceSource.metadataAuthority: Source URLs, title/platform labels and visual_focus are preserved from the supplied index, not independently re-verified claims about the screenshots or their capture hardware.
referenceSource.policy: Use observed proportions, material response, scene hierarchy and gameplay readability to build original in-engine assets; no supplied JPG is packaged as a game asset.

interpretation: Each reference contributes an observed principle to an implemented feature or a deliberately retained physical system. A mapped image is not a claim that every pictured object, vehicle, trick, map or branded event has been replicated.
invariants: The existing CourseTerrain/Track sampling remains authoritative for both collision and the visible course profile.

No Controls fields, snapshot indices, recording layouts or authored courses changed. Race distances, points and start formats are unchanged; the motocross caution eligibility correction is documented separately. Surveyed jump target speeds, engine/gearing definitions, spring/damper calibration and landing-crash thresholds are retained.
Player air pitch/roll use the existing pedal/steer inputs; AI keeps its calibrated rear-brake/pitch controller.
The dedicated race chase is restricted to the motocross class; Formula/MotoGP original camera constants and road-rider branches remain in place.
PS5 visual parity, pixel-perfect matching, photorealism and hardware performance certification are not established by this work.
